html:
Preserving the classic showroom shine of a Mercedes-Benz requires advanced protective technology that safeguards its sophisticated exterior paintwork. The factory clear coat of a luxury vehicle is constantly exposed to environmental wear, making professional paint protection a critical investment for long-term ownership. Sourced from the largest supplier of window film in the world, EliteX Graphene Surface Protection provides a high-tensile barrier designed to defend your vehicle from the harsh Australian elements while enhancing its gloss.

Graphene Infused Nanotechnology for Luxury Vehicles

The EliteX Graphene Infused formula represents a significant advancement over traditional silica-based coatings. By creating a hybrid formula that combines silicon dioxide and silicon carbide with graphene, this coating achieves exceptional hardness and bonding capability. Graphene itself is a layer of carbon just one atom thick, yet it provides remarkable strength and flexibility.

When professionally applied, the coating bonds deeply into the microscopic pores of your Mercedes-Benz paintwork. This chemical bond creates a surface that is noticeably smoother to the touch and optically shinier, enhancing the depth of the paint colour. Furthermore, the thermal resistance of this graphene hybrid formula is approximately double that of conventional ceramic coatings, offering superior protection against intense heat and sun exposure.

Exterior Paint Protection Against Australian Elements

The exterior surfaces of your vehicle are constantly exposed to environmental hazards that can degrade the clear coat over time. EliteX Graphene paint protection is designed to shield both the clear and base coats from these common threats.

This professional treatment helps prevent several types of damage:

  • Weather-induced oxidisation, fading, and loss of gloss caused by exposure to intense solar radiation.
  • Clear coat delamination and base coat deterioration.
  • Chemical etching from acidic substances including bird droppings, bat droppings, and tree sap.
  • Stains from stubborn bug splatter, fallen leaves, and industrial rail dust.
  • Hard water spots and bore water marks that can mar the paint finish.

By establishing a sacrificial barrier on top of the factory paint, the coating absorbs these environmental impacts, preserving the original finish underneath.

Complete Cabin and Tint Integration

Maintaining a luxury vehicle involves protecting more than just its exterior paintwork. The cabin of a Mercedes-Benz features premium upholstery and surface finishes that are vulnerable to daily wear, UV exposure, and accidental spills. To protect these interior elements, applying Elite X Interior Surface Protection creates a non-stick barrier that resists stains from food, beverages, makeup, and sunscreen, while preventing dehydration and cracking.

For comprehensive protection, combining a ceramic coating with high-performance window film is highly effective. Mercedes-Benz owners can choose from several advanced tint options:

  • Spectre Ceramic Tint provides exceptional climate control by rejecting 87% of infrared heat and 99% of harmful UV rays.
  • Octane Darkest Legal Tint delivers deep black styling and ultimate privacy while filtering out glare and UV radiation.
  • Black Panther Window Tint utilizes hybrid-matrix nano-ceramic technology to block 99% of infrared energy with zero electronic signal interference for GPS and mobile devices.

These high-quality films are ARPANSA certified, ensuring true specifications and maximum solar protection.

Professional Application Standards and Warranty Details

EliteX Graphene Paint Protection is a professional-grade treatment that requires skilled preparation and application. Unlike retail wax products, this permanent coating is applied in a controlled environment by trained technicians to ensure a flawless bond with the paint. Tint a Car has been supplying Australians with window film and vehicle protection products for over 50 years, ensuring high standards of workmanship across our national network.

Every EliteX application includes:

  • Decontamination of the paint surface to remove embedded road grime and microscopic particles.
  • Paint correction to eliminate minor swirls and light scratches, ensuring the highest possible gloss before sealing.
  • A nationwide limited lifetime warranty, providing peace of mind that your vehicle is protected for as long as you own it.
  • No requirement for annual inspections or costly maintenance packages to keep the warranty valid.

The investment for an EliteX ceramic coating varies, with final costs depending on your vehicle’s size and specific preparation needs.
